scientific_integrity: The corrected finding is limited to the exact positive-temperature spatial correlation prefactor. The zero-temperature theorem and block-variance transition were previously published on 2026-11-02 and are explicitly credited. Original same-model assessment is historical evidence; independent review is a distinct assessment.
scientific_limitations: Annealed equal-time correlations for a common Pareto-renewal reset of an infinite one-dimensional zero-field Glauber chain, initially iid symmetric, with alpha>1, tau0>0, and fixed strictly positive finite temperature. No novelty for zero-temperature laws and no quenched, finite-ring, joint-low-temperature or dynamical-time-correlation claim.
title: Sharp positive-temperature spatial correlation prefactor in globally Pareto-reset Glauber chains
